footnote: Source: Autonomy et al., UK pilot report, Feb 2023, for the cover buddies of staggered teams
notes: Who does what. Management approves each department's plan and confirms the stop-rule thresholds, then reviews the measures every month during the trial and decides when a rule trips. HR runs the three surveys, sets the time-keeping and rota rules, answers questions and writes the final evaluation. Department heads carry the most weight: pick the model, set the rota, file the stop-doing list by November 30, then track customer and output measures every week and report monthly. Support and always-on teams stagger their days off and pair everyone with a cover buddy so at least 80% of the team is in every weekday. Everyone else: please take the baseline survey and tell your department head which meetings and steps you would cut. Days off stay off, and anything urgent goes to the on-call rota.
